programme.title: Shock Wave 2
programme.desc: A series of bomb threats is causing fear in Hong Kong. An ex-bomb disposal officer becomes prime suspect after a terrorist attack & becomes a fugitive to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Old Fox
programme.desc: Liao Jie and his father save to buy a home but are too poor. Liao Jie learns survival skills from their landlord Old Fox and ends up hurting him, but his empathy stops him from becoming like Old Fox.

programme.title: Bursting Point
programme.desc: A failed drug raid leaves an undercover cop trapped and a drug lord vowing to seek revenge. Senior Police Inspector Li resorts to blackmailing a drug dealer with his daughter to arrest the drug lord.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: A photographer becomes entangled with a woman in red, leading to the deaths of his relatives. When the girl he likes dies mysteriously, he uncovers the secret of a 'ghost marriage'.

programme.title: The Brotherhood of Rebel
programme.desc: Chai, a triad member, helps his friend Meow flee after Meow's attempt to kill his triad boss. 17 years later, their paths cross when Meow's life is in danger again. Will Chai choose loyalty over duty?

programme.title: May Who?
programme.desc: An average high-school girl, May is on a quest to win the love of her school heartthrob. However, May has a secret: she shoots electricity whenever she gets excited.

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian military arms dealer in order to find the hidden loot and to destroy them.

programme.title: July Rhapsody
programme.desc: A 40-year-old high school teacher is in midlife crisis, his marriage is on the rocks and he is involved in a taboo romance with a female student who has a crush on him.

programme.title: Death Stranding
programme.desc: The Police and gambling association team up to overhaul underground gambling by auctioning new casino licenses. This unveils the hidden interests and secrets while sparking conflicts between gangs...

programme.title: Wolf Pack
programme.desc: Specializing in overseas security jobs, The Wolf Pack discovers that terrorists are planning to destroy the country's energy source. Lead by Lao Diao, the pack must move out to stop them!

programme.title: Undercover Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: When a low-rank triad member is informed by 3 cops that he is an undercover police officer who lost his memory, he is forced to search for the truth when he falls in love with one of the cops.

programme.title: Vanguard
programme.desc: Vanguard, a covert private security, is tasked with protecting an accountant targeted by deadly mercenaries. In the process, they also discover another dangerous conspiracy.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: Scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant super rubber seeds on a remote island to create a new land. Joined by her ex-husband, they face deadly clashes with a local drug cartel amid rising conflicts.

programme.title: Adventure of the King
programme.desc: When Emperor Zheng De fled the palace to avoid an unwanted marriage, he never expected to lose his money & his advisors. Fortunately, the kind inn owner, Phoenix, takes him in out of pity.

programme.title: The Monkey King
programme.desc: Donnie Yen, Chow Yun Fat & Aaron Kwok star in this classic-inspired tale of the Monkey King's legendary Journey To The West.

programme.title: Red Line
programme.desc: A former professional racer falls into despair after causing his brother's death. He meets Dr. Hui & becomes an ambulance driver. Meanwhile, his friends uncover the truth behind his brother's accident.

programme.title: Life Must Go On
programme.desc: When the midnight gymnasium programme for wayward teenage girls is at risk of closing down due to funding, social worker Yanki puts together a dodgeball team to compete in a match to save it.

programme.title: Look Up
programme.desc: Celebrating the 25th anniversary of HK's Handover with an anthology of 4 stories about an autistic young man, a reconciliation, a Chinese opera star & a Nepali youth.

programme.title: Lost Love
programme.desc: Mei tries to get over her young son's death by becoming a foster parent. Her dedication to the children leads her to neglect her husband. Will the couple be able to salvage their relationship?

programme.title: Romantic Dream
programme.desc: A mechanic bumps into his dream girl for the second time after making his pile. This time, he just may get to be with her, even if itis only in his dreams.

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: Based on Yuan Taiji's novel, this drama depicts how a young assassin takes his first mission while investigating his family's massacre - and finds himself far deeper than he expected.

programme.title: Love for All Seasons
programme.desc: Womanizer Tiger Hung arrives in Mount Emei to get the cure of his illness. May is the only woman who is capable to do so, but Tiger has to break her heart first before she gains the healing power.

programme.title: The Unwavering Brotherhood
programme.desc: Hua, Fei and Guo are robbed when transporting gang money. When Hua discovers that Fei and Guo are connected to the robbery, he must choose between loyalty and brotherhood.

programme.title: Everything is Unknown
programme.desc: Pan Yi Ming must attend his father's funeral to claim the huge inheritance. When he returns home, he reunites with his ex-girlfriend and her family, but ended up falling into their trap.

programme.title: Wu Xia
programme.desc: To protect his family, a martial artist hides his identity living in a remote village with his wife & two sons. He gets embroiled in a bizarre murder case & is forced into a death duel.

programme.title: Europe Raiders
programme.desc: Director Jingle Ma reunites with Tony Leung for the 3rd instalment of the Raider's series, revolving the adventure of 2 top bounty hunters as they search for the destructive missile called Hand of God.

programme.title: The Wig
programme.desc: Meng Zhong is a successful lawyer. During an investigation into a court case, he meets a girl who triggers his memories of a rainy night, revealing a long-hidden secret from 20 years ago...

programme.title: Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Five bounty hunters are tasked to track down the culprit of a series of bombings plaguing a hotel group in Bangkok. Can they solve the crime and finally collect the bounty?

programme.title: Once Upon A Time in Hong Kong
programme.desc: Helmed by four Best Actors and set in Hong Kong in the 1970s, this exciting action film charts how the ICAC dealt with corruption within the police force in its early stages of establishment.

programme.title: Hong Kong Lan Kwai Fong
programme.desc: Lee, a production head of an advertising firm, runs into her ex-boyfriend before a commercial shoot & drowns her sorrows drinking at Lan Kwai Fong. She picks herself up with Chan's help.

programme.title: Mr & Mrs Gambler
